title: Complex-level comparison induced by a homotopy derived counit
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let L : A → B be additive, let LF : D(A) → D(B) be a functor, and let epsilon : Qh_A ⋙ LF → K(L) ⋙ Qh_B be a specified natural transformation on homotopy categories. For a cochain complex P define the map LF(Q_A(P)) → Q_B(L(P)) by first applying LF to the inverse of the canonical quotient comparison at P, then applying epsilon at the homotopy image of P, then Qh_B of the factorization isomorphism between K(L)(P) and the homotopy image of L(P), and finally the quotient comparison in B. This is the already existing CategoryTheory.derivedPullbackComplexComparison; only its module location is changed.
